about: Evidence-verified destination access for Legon. An entry here overrides the automatic evidence chain in scripts/geography/build-access.mjs and must say why. Entrances are an OSM node or gate, a point measured on the georeferenced reference atlas ('at', snapped onto the named footprint), the side of a footprint met by a mapped axis or facing a direction, or where a mapped way meets the footprint, or the middle of the facade facing (or, for a back entrance, turned away from) another destination ('faces', 'awayFrom'). 'status': verified (direct visual or written evidence of the entrance), partial (evidence for the side/approach but not the exact door), unverified (listed in 'priority' with no entry here: the automatic result is kept and reported, never presented as verified). 'refs' name the user-supplied reference images (UG_BUILDINGS__LAYOUTS_AND_THEIR_STRUCTURES.zip and the two satellite atlas sheets) used as evidence; coordinates are game-frame metres measured on those images after registering them to the OSM footprints (docs/LEGON_ENTRANCE_VERIFICATION.md).

citations.user-atlas: Satellite campus reference atlas supplied by the project owner (2 sheets, Apple Maps imagery), registered to OSM footprints
citations.user-layouts: UG_BUILDINGS__LAYOUTS_AND_THEIR_STRUCTURES.zip supplied by the project owner: labelled layouts and entrance photos
citations.user-photos: Photos of the four Diaspora halls supplied by the project owner (an aerial of all four halls, a drone view of one hall's front and courtyard, two oblique drone views of the facades, a close view of the entrance pavilion), with the owner's description of how the halls face each other
citations.user-photos-jubilee-ish: Photos supplied by the project owner of Jubilee Hall (aerial of the entrance corner, courtyard) and the International Students Hostel (entrance facade), and a satellite layout of Jubilee Hall, ISH 1 and ISH 2 with the entrances and car parks marked, registered to the OSM footprints (2.8 px/m, 1° rotation)
citations.owner-banking-square: The owner's labelled aerial of the banking square (banks C, F, S, the ATM bay, the car-park entrance), the owner's photos of the CBG front and the Union Building entrance, and the owner's close-up marking the Ecobank entrance; registered to the OSM footprints by roof colour (4.2 px/m, 1° rotation)
citations.owner-vikings-law: The owner's photos of Mensah Sarbah Vikings Hostel (front with the entrances marked, the south end, an aerial with the entrances marked) and of the School of Law (two views of the entrance rotunda with the doors marked), with the earlier layout photos of both
citations.owner-engineering: The owner's satellite layout of the School of Engineering Sciences with the entrance (blue), the aeroplane enclosure (green) and the car park (red) marked, the owner's reference render with the entrance porch marked, and two photos of the front with the entrance marked
citations.owner-intl-house: The owner's photo of International House (entrance marked) and aerial of it with the School of Law (entrance and the wooded zones marked), registered to the OSM footprints at 4.4 px/m
citations.owner-pentagon: The owner's aerial of Pentagon with the New Pent blocks (A, B, C), the Old Pent courts (D, K, AA, N) and the admin block (AD) labelled and their entrances marked, registered to the OSM footprints (2.5 px/m), and photos of a New Pent block, an Old Pent court and the admin block (entrances marked)
citations.owner-commonwealth: The owner's photos of Commonwealth Hall (the gate houses and stairway from the road, the stairs, the main entrance with its gate marked, the front from above) and its aerial with the two- and three-storey parts marked, registered to the OSM footprints (1 px/m, front to the east)
citations.owner-volta: The owner's aerial of Volta Hall with the entrance marked (blue) and the storeys described, registered to the OSM footprints (0.27 m/px, north up), and photos of the entrance up its steps (marked), the front buildings either side of the climb, and the Annex.
citations.owner-sarbah-akuafo-legon: The owner's photos of Mensah Sarbah Hall (the front from above with the entrance building and its gate marked, the entrance building from the court with its two side doors marked), of the Akuafo Hall entrance (gate marked) and of the Legon Hall entrance (gate marked).
citations.owner-annexes: The owner's photos and top views of the Legon Hall annexes (Annex B's gallery face with the entrance marked; the top view of Annex A, B and C with the entrances marked and Annex C circled) and the Akuafo Hall annexes (an aerial of the four with A and B, C and D circled and C's entrance marked; a photo of a tall annex's gallery face; Annex A with its entrance marked).
citations.owner-sarbah-annexes-cc: The owner's aerial of Mensah Sarbah's annexes (the same as Akuafo's), and photos and aerials of the CC (its terrace and doors marked), the SRC Union Building opposite and the Standard Chartered ATM building between them.
citations.owner-balme: The owner's marked aerial of the Balme Library surroundings (the CEDI Conference Centre in yellow, UGCS in purple, two-floor blocks circled red, ground-floor blocks circled black, entrances marked blue), the owner's photos of CEDI from the west (the entrance porch marked), from the east and from above, and the owner's account of the Standard Chartered and Absa building; the marks placed proportionally on the OSM footprints (Google Open Buildings agrees with the OSM positions).
citations.owner-balme-library: The owner's photos of the Balme Library: the front from the south (the arched door 'THE BALME LIBRARY' up a flight of steps, and from the far end of the long pool), a top view from the south, the north-west corner, and the north side from the round fountain in the Kuffour Quadrangle.
citations.owner-night-market: The owner's aerials of the current Night Market (circled blue, the supermarket circled black) and of the buildings round it (circled yellow), registered to the OSM footprints (the bank compound at 4.9 px/m, the wider area at 3.6 px/m).
citations.owner-valco: The owner's photo of Valco Trust Hostel Phase 1 and Phase 2 (Phase 1's entrance marked in blue) and the owner's account: the back of Phase 1 faces the back of Phase 2.
citations.owner-west-legon: The owner's map of the buildings west of Legon Hall (Language Center, Modern Languages, Confucius Institute, the barbeque joint), the owner's two photos of them from the air, and the owner's aerial of the bungalows behind them (circled white), registered to the OSM footprints at 2.8 px/m.
citations.owner-sph: The owner's aerial of the School of Public Health (wings marked yellow: two floors, white: three floors; entrances circled blue; structures circled purple gone), registered to the OSM footprints at 4.0 px/m, and the owner's photo of its three-floor front.

campusGates.name: Main Gate
campusGates.access: vehicles with a UG permit; pedestrians and cyclists
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the Main gate (opposite the Legon Police Station)'. OSM: two permit lift gates across Dr. J.B. Danquah Avenue at the gatehouse, 175 m west of the police station across the N4.

campusGates.name: North Gate
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the North gate (close to the James Topp-Nelson Yankah Hall, Haatso Road)'. OSM: two permit lift gates 100 m north-west of the hall on the road to the Haatso road.

campusGates.name: Link Gate
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the Link Gate' from the Achimota-Legon road. OSM: permit lift gates on the tertiary road beside the road named 'Link Gate'.

campusGates.name: Okponglo (Stadium Road) entrance
campusGates.access: open to the public 24 hours (2014 directive)
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the Stadium Road entrance at the Okponglo intersection ... remains open 24 hours to the general public'; a security access gate building was commissioned on the road near the stadium. OSM: a public lift gate and a permissive swing gate on the road from the Okponglo junction past the stadium.

campusGates.name: South Gate
campusGates.evidence: Written: 'the South gate (from Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research to National Highway 4)'. OSM: a permit gate on the road running east from the Noguchi area to the N4. Which of the two permit gates in the south-east is the named South Gate is not stated; this is the one on the Noguchi road.

destinations.approach: From the N4 (J.J. Rawlings Avenue) turn west into Dr. J.B. Danquah Avenue and pass the inbound lift gate at the gatehouse.
destinations.evidence: UG security directive: 'the Main gate (opposite the Legon Police Station)'; OSM permit lift gates at the gatehouse on the inbound carriageway; reference atlas shows the gatehouse straddling the avenue.

destinations.approach: Along the avenue to the fountain roundabout, then north up the forecourt lanes to the library's south front.
destinations.evidence: Owner's photos: the round-arched door 'THE BALME LIBRARY' in the middle of the one-floor entrance range on the south front, up a flight of steps, on the axis of the long pool (OSM way 320067568) and the forecourt lanes (ways 448104199, 448104193). The back (north) faces the Kuffour Quadrangle and its round fountain.
refs: owner's photos of the Balme Library

destinations.approach: Up Legon Hill on the axial road from the east, stop at its turning loop, then cross the Convocation courtyard west to the hall's east front.
destinations.evidence: great_hall_and_directorate_4: the public front is the gable end with three doors at the end of a long paved courtyard with lawn panels between low flanking wings, the tower beside it. great_hall_and_directorate_3: the opposite (west) end is the curved, terraced end above the loop road. Reference atlas sheet 2: the paved courtyard lies east of the hall, between it and the axial road loop (OSM way 424526319). Previous entrance (west side, at the turning circles) was the back of the hall.

secondary.label: west turning circles (service / back of the hall)
secondary.evidence: OSM turning circles on the summit loop at the curved west end

destinations.approach: Ride onto the square's paths and stop in the middle of the square, between the library front and the fountain.
destinations.evidence: UG text: 'mid-way [along the avenue] is an open space, the University Square, with an ornamental fountain'. The square's outline is derived from the lanes that bound it (no source maps it).

destinations.approach: Viewed and reached from the University Square's south edge; the fountain sits on the avenue roundabout island.
destinations.evidence: OSM fountain polygon (way 320067568) inside the avenue roundabout; the square lies directly north of it.

destinations.approach: Up Legon Hill to the service road south of the Convocation Group and its car park.
destinations.evidence: OSM 'University of Ghana Registry' node lies inside this building (OSM names it 'Cash office'); Apple's 'University of Ghana Registry' label in reference atlas sheet 2 sits on the same block; OSM car park (way 720486435) and service road (way 720486437) adjoin its south side. Exact door not visible.

destinations.approach: Behind (north of) the Balme Library; enter the formal garden from its south edge on the central path.
destinations.evidence: Radio Univers: 'Balme Library Gardens / Kuffuor Quadrangle', behind the library. Atlas sheet 2 shows the symmetric formal garden with its central axis aligned on the library.

destinations.approach: From the road along the north side through the big entrance in the middle of the compound's north wing into the courtyard car park.
destinations.evidence: Owner's labelled aerial: the middle of the north wing (marked in red) is the big entrance to the courtyard car park (marked yellow); registered to the OSM footprint, it is the north wing between the ATM bay and the Stanbic corner.

destinations.approach: From the road along the east side of the market, between the supermarket and the stall rows.
destinations.evidence: Owner's aerial: the market lies west of the banking square, its lanes open onto the road on the east side between the supermarket (north) and the stall sheds (south).
refs: owner's aerial of the Night Market

destinations.approach: Along the avenue's southern carriageway, turn into the paved forecourt on the hall's axis and stop at the north front.
destinations.evidence: Business listings place the Legon Hall Porters Lodge on J. B. Danquah Road (the avenue). legon_hall_layout (registered to OSM): the hall's spine footway (OSM 1186587902/614159986) runs north to this block; atlas sheet 2 shows a paved forecourt from the avenue to its north face. legon_hall_entrance photo: arched front with a paved forecourt. Note: Apple's 'Legon Hall' pin sits on OSM 'Maison Francais' to the east, which is a different building. Owner's photo of the entrance with the gate marked agrees.

secondary.label: Legon Hall Southern Gate
secondary.evidence: Apple label 'Legon Hall Southern Gate' in legon_hall_layout

destinations.approach: Off the avenue's southern carriageway onto the forecourt footway, to the arched gatehouse that leads into the fountain court.
destinations.evidence: akuafo_hall_layout (registered to OSM): the forecourt footway (OSM 606687250 / 603522802) leaves the avenue and passes through the arch of this north block into the circular fountain court; akuafo_hall_entrance: stone-paved forecourt with curved paths and circular planters at the entrance. Previous entrance was an inferred point on the service road east of the hall. Owner's photo of the entrance with the gate marked agrees.

destinations.approach: Along Mensah Sarbah Crescent into the semicircular drive in front of the porters' lodge archway.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the entrance is the Administration and Porters' Lodge on the north side, its gate in the middle of the front toward the semicircular drive (owner's aerial photo with the building and gate marked, and the owner's panorama of the hall with the entrance marked: a two-storey building with a small lantern, joined to the wings either side). OSM: the drive is way 1540994843 and the building way 300288063. The building with the tall gold lantern, seven tall louvred windows and the stone terrace (the owner's court photo) is the dining hall across the court on the south, as the panorama shows.
refs: sarbah_court (owner: the dining hall's court side)

destinations.approach: From Volta Hall Road across the forecourt between the two front buildings, then up the steps to the arched entrance on the east face.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the entrance is the section marked blue on the aerial, on the east face of the front block; the photos show the arched doorway with its gate at the top of a short flight of steps between stone walls, with a two-storey building either side of the climb.
refs: volta_front (owner photo, entrance and front building marked)

destinations.approach: On foot: between the two gate houses at the end of the avenue and up the long stairway to the drive, then into the main entrance (the gate in the middle of the front block). By road: the drive round the front.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the two single-storey gate houses mark the way into the Commonwealth grounds; between them the stairway climbs the hill to the main entrance, whose gate is in the middle of the two-storey front block (owner's photos, gate marked). The aerial (registered) puts the front block across the east end, on the avenue axis.

secondary.label: the gate houses at the foot of the stairway
secondary.evidence: Owner's photo: two small single-storey buildings either side of the foot of the stairway, by the road at the end of the avenue.

destinations.approach: Into the car park between Sey and JNA; the front entrance is the gabled pavilion in the middle of the facade facing JNA.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the four Diaspora halls are one design and are built in facing pairs (Limann and Kwapong, Sey and Jean Nelson); each pair's front entrances face each other across their car parks. Owner photos: the front entrance is a projecting gabled pavilion at the centre of the long facade (tall arched window above a columned porch), on the axis of the car park; the aerial of all four halls shows the facing fronts on one axis with a walkway between them.

secondary.label: back entrance (no car park)
secondary.evidence: Owner: every hall also has a back entrance, without a car park. Owner photos: the same gabled pavilion sits at the centre of the opposite long facade.

destinations.approach: Into the car park between JNA and Sey; the front entrance is the gabled pavilion in the middle of the facade facing Sey.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the four Diaspora halls are one design and are built in facing pairs (Limann and Kwapong, Sey and Jean Nelson); each pair's front entrances face each other across their car parks. Owner photos: the front entrance is a projecting gabled pavilion at the centre of the long facade (tall arched window above a columned porch), on the axis of the car park; the aerial of all four halls shows the facing fronts on one axis with a walkway between them.

secondary.label: back entrance (no car park)
secondary.evidence: Owner: every hall also has a back entrance, without a car park. Owner photos: the same gabled pavilion sits at the centre of the opposite long facade.

destinations.approach: Into the car park between Kwapong and Limann; the front entrance is the gabled pavilion in the middle of the facade facing Limann.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the four Diaspora halls are one design and are built in facing pairs (Limann and Kwapong, Sey and Jean Nelson); each pair's front entrances face each other across their car parks. Owner photos: the front entrance is a projecting gabled pavilion at the centre of the long facade (tall arched window above a columned porch), on the axis of the car park; the aerial of all four halls shows the facing fronts on one axis with a walkway between them.

secondary.label: back entrance (no car park)
secondary.evidence: Owner: every hall also has a back entrance, without a car park. Owner photos: the same gabled pavilion sits at the centre of the opposite long facade.

destinations.approach: Into the car park between Limann and Kwapong; the front entrance is the gabled pavilion in the middle of the facade facing Kwapong.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the four Diaspora halls are one design and are built in facing pairs (Limann and Kwapong, Sey and Jean Nelson); each pair's front entrances face each other across their car parks. Limann is the first of the four halls on the way in from Jubilee Link. Owner photos: the front entrance is a projecting gabled pavilion at the centre of the long facade (tall arched window above a columned porch), on the axis of the car park; the aerial of all four halls shows the facing fronts on one axis with a walkway between them.

secondary.label: back entrance (no car park)
secondary.evidence: Owner: every hall also has a back entrance, without a car park. Owner photos: the same gabled pavilion sits at the centre of the opposite long facade.

destinations.approach: From the car park east of the hall to the entrance in the south-east corner, beside the white entrance block with the round tower.
destinations.evidence: Owner's marked layout (registered to OSM): the entrance is in the re-entrant corner at the hall's south-east end (the notch in OSM relation 3697984), beside the car park between Jubilee and ISH 1. Owner's aerial photo: the entrance block there, white with a flat roof, a round white tower, a portico and water tanks. Earlier evidence (jubilee_hall_4, jubilee_hall_layout) puts the porch at the same corner.
refs: jubilee_ish_layout (owner satellite layout with entrances and car parks marked)

destinations.approach: From the main road on the south, down the gentle hill on the access road to the forecourt, then into the porch with SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING on its band.
destinations.evidence: Owner's layout (registered to OSM at 0.25 m/px): the entrance is the porch in the middle of the front (south) block, where OSM maps the projecting porch (447.8-457.6 x, to -379.9 z). Owner's render and photos: a porch on white columns under a tile roof, its band lettered SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING in blue capitals. The owner: the building lies below the road, reached by going down a gentle hill.

destinations.approach: From the road north of the school, through its car park to the covered walkway along the north front.
destinations.evidence: business_school_layout (registered to OSM): the car park and access road lie along the north side, with a covered walkway on the north facade. Door not visible.

destinations.approach: From the avenue side by the footpaths that converge on the building's south front.
destinations.evidence: Radio Univers: JQB is 'close to the Main Entrance ... behind the Institute of African Studies, on your right side when coming from the main gate'. Atlas sheet 2 + OSM: the footpaths from the avenue side converge on the south face. Previous entrance was an inferred point at the north-east corner (the back).

destinations.approach: From the road on the east into the paved courtyard, then up the steps to the glass doors of the round entrance building.
destinations.evidence: Owner photos: the entrance is the glass doors at the foot of the round entrance building (the LAW crest above), reached up wide steps from the courtyard, with the long four-storey block to its right and the tiled south block to its left. Placed on the layout photo registered to Google's footprint: the rotunda's face toward the courtyard, which opens to the road on the east.

destinations.approach: From the road west of the stadium to the main (west) grandstand.
destinations.evidence: Atlas sheet 1: the covered main grandstand is on the west side of the bowl, facing the road and the gym centre. Spectator gates are not mapped.

destinations.approach: From the road along the south side, facing the Central Cafeteria.
destinations.evidence: athletic_oval_labeled: paths enter the oval at its south end; Radio Univers: the CC is 'opposite Athletic Oval' (CC lies to the south).

destinations.approach: From the car park between Jubilee Hall and ISH 1 to the gabled porch on the hostel's north facade.
destinations.evidence: Owner's marked layout (registered to OSM): the entrance is on ISH 1's north facade, a little east of its middle, facing the car park it shares with Jubilee Hall. Owner photo of the hostel: a small gabled porch on the long four-storey facade, behind the car park, a little off-centre.
refs: jubilee_ish_layout (owner satellite layout with entrances and car parks marked)

destinations.approach: From the Haatso-Atomic road side into the gardens' main entrance.
destinations.evidence: OSM entrance=main (node 2248903579) on the gardens' boundary; Visit Ghana: the gardens are 'off Atomic Haatso Main Road at Agbogba Junction'.

destinations.approach: From the car park between ISH 2 and Jubilee Hall to the entrance canopy on the hostel's south facade.
destinations.evidence: Owner's marked layout (registered to OSM): the entrance is on ISH 2's south facade, east of its middle, at the corner of the car park between ISH 2 and Jubilee Hall. Owner: ISH 2 has the same structure as ISH 1. international_students_hostel_1: the balconied facade with a flat entrance canopy and a car park in front.
refs: jubilee_ish_layout (owner satellite layout with entrances and car parks marked)

destinations.approach: From the road along the south side (the way in from the Diaspora halls and the Night Market) to the CBG door with its steps and red pillars.
destinations.evidence: Owner: CBG is the west wing (C) and its entrance is on the south side, facing you as you come from the Diaspora route or the Night Market. Owner photo: the CBG front with steps, red pillars, a canopy sign and flags.

destinations.approach: From the road along the south side, up the steps under UMB's dark gable.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the bank next to CBG in the south wing (labelled F) is UMB. Owner photo of the UMB front: a porch on white pillars under a dark gable with the yellow umb logo, steps up to glass doors; like CBG's, it faces the road on the south side.

destinations.approach: From the road along the north side to the Stanbic door in the north face of the compound's north-east corner block.
destinations.evidence: Owner's close-up of the compound with the Stanbic entrance circled: the passage in the north face of the north-east corner block, facing the road and car park on the north (registered to the OSM footprint at 4.4 px/m).

destinations.approach: To the north notch of the Union Building, between its two north wings.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the Ecobank entrance is the blue-circled spot in the owner's close-up of the Union Building (the notch between the two north wings) and looks like the Union Building entrance in the owner's photo.

destinations.approach: To the east notch of the Union Building, facing the car park and the loop road.
destinations.evidence: Owner's photo: the Union Building entrance (sign 'ALUMNI BUILDING') across a block-paved forecourt, with the Ecobank-blue wing beside it. OSM maps an entrance node in the east notch; the photo's angle is not fixed, so the side is partial.

destinations.approach: From the car park south of the hostel to the single-storey VIKINGS HOSTEL entrance block in the inner corner of the L.
destinations.evidence: Owner's front photo: the big entrance area is the single-storey block with the VIKINGS HOSTEL sign, its door at the left of the block; owner's aerial: the same block in the inner corner of the L (south of the east wing, east of the long wing), facing the car park. OSM maps the block as the extension at 156-171.5 x, 832.5-840.5 z.

secondary.label: door at the foot of the long wing's south end
secondary.evidence: Owner's front photo and aerial: a second door at the south end of the long wing (the small mark on the left).

destinations.approach: From the law-school road (Annie Jiagge Road) through the car park on the west to the entrance porch with the white arch.
destinations.evidence: Owner's aerial (registered): the entrance is the porch on the west face, toward the car park and the road opposite the School of Law; OSM maps the porch there (544-551 x, -205.6 to -198.3 z). Owner's photo: a single-storey porch with a tile roof and a white arched gable in front of the four-storey block.

destinations.approach: From the road along the halls into the open front of the dome site (no gate), across the lawn to the halls' doors.
destinations.evidence: Owner's aerial: the front of the lawn between the two big halls, facing the road, is open (no gate); the halls have several doors onto the lawn (marked). Owner's map: the dome lies north-west of the Lizalex Quadrangle.
refs: diaspora_dome_aerial (owner, open front and gates marked)

destinations.approach: From the car park south of the block to the entrance pavilion in the middle of its central wing.
destinations.evidence: Owner's aerial (marked, registered): the entrance is at the south face of the central cross-shaped wing; owner's photo: a projecting pavilion with a columned, arched porch under a small tile gable, an arched window high in the tower.

destinations.approach: From the car park south of the block to the entrance pavilion in its central wing.
destinations.evidence: Owner's aerial (marked, registered); same design as Block A (owner).

destinations.approach: From the car park south of the block to the entrance pavilion in its central wing.
destinations.evidence: Owner's aerial (marked, registered); same design as Block A (owner).

destinations.approach: From the road along the north of Old Pent to the porch in the middle of the court's north face.
destinations.evidence: Owner: Dar es Salaam is the westernmost Old Pent court (D); entrance marked on its north face. Owner's photo of a court: a small tiled porch at the foot of the central stair core.

destinations.approach: From the road along the north of Old Pent to the porch in the middle of the court's north face.
destinations.evidence: Owner: Kampala is the second court from the west (K), entrance marked on its north face.

destinations.approach: From the road along the north of Old Pent to the porch in the middle of the court's north face.
destinations.evidence: Owner: Addis Ababa is the court east of the admin block (AA), entrance marked on its north face.

destinations.approach: From the road along the north of Old Pent to the gabled porch between the admin block's two towers.
destinations.evidence: Owner: the admin block (AD) sits in the middle of Old Pent with two courts either side; entrance marked on its north face. Owner's photo: a gabled porch with a sunburst gable and the GHANA HOSTELS LTD sign between two gabled towers.

destinations.approach: To the ground-floor entrance at the east end of the north (gallery) face.
destinations.evidence: Owner: Legon Hall Annex A and B are one design and face the same way; the entrance is on the ground floor at the east end of the gallery face (north), marked on the owner's photo of Annex B and the top view.
refs: owner's annex photos and top views (entrances marked)

destinations.approach: To the ground-floor entrance at the east end of the north (gallery) face.

refs: owner's annex photos and top views (entrances marked)

destinations.approach: To the ground-floor entrance on the south face, in line with the stair tower.
destinations.evidence: Owner's photo of Annex A (entrance marked): the entrance is on the ground floor of the long block, in line with the stair tower, on the face toward Annex B (south); A and B face each other.
